title: Unique Parents
statement: Implement `solve(ids)`. `ids` is a list of parent ids repeated once per joined child. Return the unique ids in first-seen order.
hints: A seen set plus a result list.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: joinedload of a collection repeats the parent row once per child in the raw result.

editorial: joinedload of a collection repeats the parent row once per child in the raw result. unique() collapses those repeats. Forgetting it returns duplicate parents to the API. First-seen order matches the parent's order in the joined stream.
